API Reference

scrape.py

scrape.py

Scrape GradCafe survey pages to collect result URLs and parse key application fields from each result page into applicant_data.json.

scrape.extract_result_urls_from_survey(html: str) → list[str][source]

Parse a GradCafe survey listing page and return unique full result URLs found on that page.

scrape.fetch_html(url: str, timeout: int = 30) → str[source]

Download raw HTML from a URL using urllib with a browser-like User-Agent header.

scrape.load_existing_records(path: str) → list[dict][source]

Load existing JSON records from disk, or return an empty list if not found/invalid.

scrape.parse_result_page(url: str) → dict[source]

Download one GradCafe result page and extract structured application fields from the Application Information <dl> block.

scrape.safe_fetch_html(url: str, timeout: int = 30, retries: int = 3, backoff_sec: float = 1.0) → str | None[source]

Fetch HTML with retries so one timeout/429 doesn’t crash the entire scrape.

scrape.save_json(records: list[dict], path: str) → None[source]

Save a list of applicant record dictionaries to a JSON file.

scrape.scrape_data(max_pages: int = 5, delay_sec: float = 0.5) → list[dict][source]

Scrape multiple survey pages, parse each result URL, and return a list of applicant records. Resumes from OUTPUT_JSON if it already exists.

clean.py

clean.py

Load applicant_data.json, normalize fields (numbers, blanks, dates), and write cleaned_applicant_data.json.

clean.blank_to_none(value: Any) → Any[source]

Convert empty strings (or whitespace-only strings) to None; leave everything else unchanged.

clean.clean_record(record: dict) → dict[source]

Convert one scraped record into a cleaned record with normalized types and parsed notification fields.

clean.main() → None[source]

Load applicant_data.json, clean all records, and write cleaned_applicant_data.json.

clean.normalize_decision(decision: Any) → str | None[source]

Normalize decision strings into a consistent capitalization (e.g., Accepted, Rejected, Interview).

clean.parse_notification(notification: Any) → dict[source]

Extract notification_date and notification_method from a notification string when possible.

clean.to_float(value: Any) → float | None[source]

Convert a value to float when possible; return None if it is missing or invalid.

clean.to_int(value: Any) → int | None[source]

Convert a value to int when possible; return None if it is missing or invalid.

app.py (Flask)

app.py

Flask web application for displaying GradCafe SQL analysis.

Features: - Displays results of Module 3 analytical queries. - Allows reloading data from Module 2 and Module 3 pipeline. - Prevents concurrent data pulls using a lock file. - Connects directly to PostgreSQL using fixed credentials.

app.build_blocks() → list[dict[str, Any]][source]

Execute all rubric and extra credit queries.

Returns:

List of result blocks for rendering.

app.create_app(*, build_blocks_fn=<function build_blocks>, lock_exists_fn=<function lock_exists>, run_pull_fn=<function run_pull_pipeline>) → Flask[source]

Create and configure the Flask application.

Parameters:

  • build_blocks_fn – Function that returns the analysis blocks for rendering.

  • lock_exists_fn – Function that reports whether a pull is in progress.

  • run_pull_fn – Function that performs the pull/load pipeline.

Returns:

Configured Flask app instance for running or testing.

app.create_lock() → None[source]

Create a lock file to indicate an active data pull.

app.fetch_one(sql: str, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → tuple[list[str], list[tuple]][source]

Execute a SQL query and return column headers and rows.

Parameters:

  • sql – SQL query string.

  • params – Optional parameter dictionary.

Returns:

Tuple of (column names, query results).

app.get_conn() → Connection[source]

Create and return a PostgreSQL connection using DATABASE_URL.

For tests, allow overriding the connection string via Flask config: app.config[“DATABASE_URL”].

app.lock_exists() → bool[source]

Check whether a data pull operation is currently running.

Returns:

True if the lock file exists.

app.remove_lock() → None[source]

Remove the lock file when a data pull finishes.

app.run_pull_pipeline() → None[source]

Execute scraping, cleaning, and loading pipeline.

Prevents concurrent execution using a lock file.
